title: WOS native reference due-process profile
description: Closed referenceDueProcess/1 policy, native requests, immutable facts, and fixture evidence. Hosted delivery and legal qualification remain unsupported.

examples: With verified income below the threshold, the alternate evaluation did not trigger denial.

OperationKind.description: Named governed action bound to a workflow transition by the reference policy.

RefusalCode.description: Machine-readable reason the reference governor refused to admit a request.

ReferenceProfile.description: Versioned profile identifier selecting the reference due-process execution semantics.

Channel.description: Channel through which the household filed the appeal in the selected reference policy.

DeliveryChannel.description: Channel selected for issuing a notice under the reference due-process policy.

EvidenceClass.description: Evidence class used when a qualified receipt comes from the reference software fixture.

AppealAnchor.description: Event that anchors the appeal window for the selected reference due-process policy.

GraceAnchor.description: Observation that anchors the grace period in the selected reference due-process policy.

ContinuationChoicePolicy.description: Whether continuation requires an affirmative election or applies unless the household waives it.

ContinuationChoice.description: Household choice about continuing the current service level during the appeal process.

ContinuationStatus.description: Current status of the continuation protection for the household's existing service level.

ContinuationScope.description: Level of service protected when the appeal policy grants continuation to the household.

ContinuationEnd.description: Which events can end continued service during an appeal under the selected policy.

ExcludedDeterminationActors.description: Determination roles excluded from serving as the independent appeal reviewer.

HearingPurpose.description: Purpose of the clock that tracks the requirement to hold an appeal hearing.

DispositionOutcome.description: Whether the appeal disposition upheld or reversed the original determination.

NoticeStatus.description: Current native transport qualification status of a notice that has been issued.

SourceAuthority.description: Category of authority declared by the retained source cited in the policy.

CounterfactualKind.description: Direction of a tested case change in the reference determination's counterfactual evidence.

ReasoningTier.description: Field disclosure tier for the reasoning evidence attached to the original determination.

CounterfactualTier.description: Field disclosure tier for the counterfactual evidence attached to the original determination.

AcknowledgementKind.description: Status reported when the transport accepts notice work for processing.

ReceiptKind.description: Kind of receipt observation admitted by the reference notice requirements.

FailureKind.description: Transport outcome for a fixture attempt that failed before producing an external effect.

FailureCode.description: Recorded cause of a reference notice transport failure or exhausted attempt budget.

value.description: String value compared without conversion when the selector declares the string branch.
Numeric value compared without conversion when the selector declares the number branch.
Boolean value compared without conversion when the selector declares the boolean branch.

appealId.description: Identity of the existing appeal whose hearing the caller requests to schedule.

reviewerActor.description: Canonical human identity requested for independent assignment to the appeal hearing.

appealId.description: Identity of the existing appeal whose scheduled hearing the caller records as held.
Identity of the existing appeal for which the caller records a disposition.

rationale.description: Explanation supplied by the reviewer when recording the proposed appeal disposition.
examples: The documents entered at the hearing establish eligibility.

appealId.description: Identity of the existing appeal for the request to end continuation of service.

rationale.description: Reason supplied with the household's request to terminate continuation of service.
examples: The household requested an end to continued service on its signed form.

calendarDays.description: Number of whole calendar days requested for the extension of the pre-notice window.

rationale.description: Reason supplied with the request to extend the window before issuing notice.
examples: The reviewer needs more time to verify the submitted records.

appealId.description: Identity of the appeal associated with the successfully scheduled hearing.
Identity of the appeal associated with the hearing recorded as held.
Identity of the appeal to which the recorded disposition applies.

overrideRecordId.description: Identity of the retained override record for the approved extension.

operationRecordId.description: Identity of the retained governance operation returned upon successful admission.

OverrideAuthorityMethod.description: Verification method used to establish the actor's authorized role for the override.

OverrideEvidenceKind.description: Category of the retained supporting evidence cited to justify an override.

Id.description: Authored identifier starting with a letter and scoped to the containing reference document.

Token.description: Bounded token made of letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens for reference inputs.

Digest.description: SHA-256 digest encoded with a sha256 prefix and lowercase hexadecimal bytes.

SnapshotDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of a retained snapshot using lowercase hexadecimal without an algorithm prefix.

Timestamp.description: UTC date and time in the canonical format required for native reference records.

Pointer.description: JSON Pointer that selects a location in the JSON document identified by the containing field.

Human.description: Canonical human actor identity used to bind a real execution participant to a declared role.

RecordId.description: Identity used to reference a retained record produced by the native governor.

Days.description: Number of whole calendar days in a window configured by the reference due-process policy.

ProtectedCharacteristicBinding.description: Explicit source-backed protected scalar selected for isolated negative evaluation.

casePointer.description: Case-state JSON pointer of the selected protected scalar.

sourceRefs.description: Exact retained sources supporting the protected scalar selection.
